title: Resilience4j-Style Microservice Circuit Breaker
description: Create a 3-state circuit breaker that tracks failure rates and trips open to prevent cascading outages.
derived_requirements: State machine transitions: CLOSED -> OPEN -> HALF_OPEN -> CLOSED
Track failure rate over rolling execution window
Return immediate fallback response when OPEN without network calls
Allow probe requests in HALF_OPEN state

required_behavior: Fast-fail requests in OPEN state within <1ms
Transition to HALF_OPEN after recovery cooldown window
forbidden_behavior: Flooding overwhelmed downstream service while circuit is tripped

failure_taxonomy.description: Downstream service failure causes thread exhaustion in upstream callers.

ground_truth_rationale: Distributed systems require circuit breaking to prevent cascading service collapse.
